import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class bubblestrike {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader f = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(f.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        double P = Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());
        
        int lo = 0, hi = N;
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (calculateProbability(mid, N - mid) >= P) {
                hi = mid;
            } else {
                lo = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(lo);

    public static double calculateProbability(int studied, int unstudied) {
        int total = studied + unstudied;
        
        // Total ways to choose 3 maps from N
        long totalWays = (long)total * (total - 1) * (total - 2) / 6;
        
        // Count favorable cases where at least one studied map is selected
        // Case 1: 1 studied, 2 unstudied
        long case1 = (long)studied * (long)(unstudied) * (unstudied - 1) / 2;
        
        // Case 2: 2 studied, 1 unstudied
        long case2 = (long)studied * (studied - 1) / 2 * (long)unstudied;
        
        // Case 3: 3 studied
        long case3 = (long)studied * (studied - 1) * (studied - 2) / 6;
        
        long favorable = case1 + case2 + case3;
        
        // Probability that at least one studied map is in the initial 3
        double probAtLeastOneStudied = (double)favorable / totalWays;
        
        // Given that at least one studied map is in the 3, calculate probability that 
        // the final map played is studied
        // If 1 studied in 3: probability = 1/3 (system picks randomly among non-discarded)
        // If 2 studied in 3: probability = 2/3
        // If 3 studied in 3: probability = 1
        
        // But we need to be more careful: each player discards one map randomly
        // Let's recalculate more precisely
        
        // Actually, let's compute the exact probability:
        // The game system selects 3 maps: S studied, U unstudied (S+U=3)
        // Each player randomly picks one of the 3 to discard
        // System then randomly picks one of the maps not discarded
        
        // We need: P(final map is studied)
        
        // Let's enumerate all possibilities:
        // For each combination of 3 maps, and for each discard choice by both players
        
        double totalProb = 0.0;
        
        // Case 0 studied maps in the 3 selected (all unstudied)
        if (unstudied >= 3) {
            long ways0 = (long)unstudied * (unstudied - 1) * (unstudied - 2) / 6;
            // If all 3 are unstudied, final map is definitely unstudied
            totalProb += 0.0 * ways0;
        }
        
        // Case 1 studied map in the 3 selected
        if (studied >= 1 && unstudied >= 2) {
            long ways1 = (long)studied * (long)unstudied * (unstudied - 1) / 2;
            // With 1 studied and 2 unstudied, what's P(final is studied)?
            // Players each pick one of 3 maps to discard uniformly at random
            // There are 3*3 = 9 possible discard combinations
            
            // Let's label: S, U1, U2
            // System picks randomly from maps not discarded by either player
            
            // Count cases where final map is studied:
            // - If neither player discards S, and at least one discards each U
            //   Then S remains and is picked (prob 1)
            // - If one player discards S, then S is gone
            // - If both discard same map, that map is definitely discarded
            
            // Better approach: enumerate all 9 discard pairs
            int favorable1 = 0;
            // Players pick independently: each picks 0 (S), 1 (U1), or 2 (U2)
            for (int p1 = 0; p1 < 3; p1++) {
                for (int p2 = 0; p2 < 3; p2++) {
                    boolean[] discarded = new boolean[3];
                    discarded[p1] = true;
                    discarded[p2] = true;
                    
                    // Count how many maps remain
                    int remaining = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                        if (!discarded[i]) remaining++;
                    }
                    
                    if (remaining > 0) {
                        // System picks randomly among remaining
                        // Probability that studied map (index 0) is picked
                        if (!discarded[0]) {
                            favorable1 += 1.0 / remaining;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            double probGiven1 = (double)favorable1 / 9.0;
            totalProb += probGiven1 * ways1;
        }
        
        // Case 2 studied maps in the 3 selected
        if (studied >= 2 && unstudied >= 1) {
            long ways2 = (long)studied * (studied - 1) / 2 * (long)unstudied;
            // With 2 studied (S1, S2) and 1 unstudied (U)
            
            int favorable2 = 0;
            for (int p1 = 0; p1 < 3; p1++) {
                for (int p2 = 0; p2 < 3; p2++) {
                    boolean[] discarded = new boolean[3];
                    discarded[p1] = true;
                    discarded[p2] = true;
                    
                    int remaining = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                        if (!discarded[i]) remaining++;
                    }
                    
                    if (remaining > 0) {
                        // Count probability that final map is studied
                        // Maps 0,1 are studied, map 2 is unstudied
                        if (!discarded[0]) favorable2 += 1.0 / remaining;
                        if (!discarded[1]) favorable2 += 1.0 / remaining;
                    }
                }
            }
            double probGiven2 = (double)favorable2 / 9.0;
            totalProb += probGiven2 * ways2;
        }
        
        // Case 3 studied maps in the 3 selected
        if (studied >= 3) {
            long ways3 = (long)studied * (studied - 1) * (studied - 2) / 6;
            // All 3 are studied, so final map is definitely studied
            totalProb += 1.0 * ways3;
        }
        
        return totalProb / totalWays;
    }
